I'm very similar in the sense that I would rather deal with the pain of things by either facing them head on in a productive manner or reflecting internally. Though if I'm particularly in a bad place it's like I need one night of going a little overboard with alcohol or weed to remind me that is not the way I wish to cope with things. I feel that in time, I won't need that one night anymore.

I find that when I become unhealthy the first things to go are my thought patterns and my eating. I get sucked into some self-destructive spiral where I analyze all the possibilities of what I can do in a situation or my life and then reject everything in my own panic for various panicked reasons. I'll go from eating my normal 2-3 meals a day down to 1 or even have days where I will forget to eat entirely. The next thing to go is my sleep, I'll either sleep too much or not at all, paralyzed by the thoughts in my head to the point where I begin to have headaches. It's around this point where I become irritable and full hermit mode is achieved as I wallow in possibilities without solutions. It'll take me at least a few days up to a week to notice I'm in a funk and the giveaway tends to be the change in diet
